title: Which word fits the blank? | 병원 Korean quiz
description:
MalmoeLab Korean fill-in-the-blank short for English learners.

Question: 몸이 안 좋아서 ___에 전화했습니다.
Answer: 병원 (byeongwon)
Meaning: hospital
Example: 몸이 안 좋아서 병원에 전화했습니다.
English: I called the hospital because I was not feeling well.
